verdict.rationale: Veriff documents official SDKs across web, iOS, Android, and React Native, plus REST APIs, webhooks, and HMAC-signed authentication, giving developers multiple first-party integration paths (veriff-docs-2, veriff-docs-19, veriff-docs-21, veriff-docs-22, veriff-docs-23, veriff-docs-24, veriff-docs-10). Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (probe for openapi.json returned 404s) and no independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond first-party docs.
